text: I hope you are well. I am writing to let you know about some building work that we are planning to have done at number 14 next month.
We are having a new kitchen fitted and a small extension built at the back of the house. The builders are due to start on Monday 3 June, and the work should take about five weeks.

I am afraid there is likely to be some noise, particularly during the first two weeks, when the old kitchen wall is taken down. There will also be a skip on the road in front of our house, which may make parking a little more difficult for you.

To keep disruption to a minimum, I have asked the builders to work only between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. on weekdays, and never at weekends. They have also promised to clean the pavement at the end of each day. If anything causes you a problem, please do not hesitate to knock on our door.
Thank you in advance for your patience and understanding.

note.en: Specifies when it will be noisiest.
Introduces the purpose of the measures.

strengths.en: The problems are not hidden but are softened: “I am afraid”, “may make … a little more difficult”.
strengths.kk: Мәселелер жасырылмаған, бірақ жұмсақ берілген: «I am afraid», «may make … a little more difficult».
strengths.ru: Проблемы не скрыты, но поданы мягко: «I am afraid», «may make … a little more difficult».
strengths.example: I am afraid there is likely to be some noise

strengths.en: Working hours, weekends and cleaning show the neighbour has been considered.
strengths.kk: Жұмыс уақыты, демалыс, тазалау — көрші өзін ойлағанын көреді.
strengths.ru: Часы работы, выходные, уборка — сосед видит, что о нём подумали.
strengths.example: between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. on weekdays

strengths.en: “Having a new kitchen fitted” is accurate grammar: the builders do the work.
strengths.kk: «having a new kitchen fitted» — дәл грамматика: жұмысты құрылысшылар жасайды.
strengths.ru: «having a new kitchen fitted» — точная грамматика: работу делают строители.
strengths.example: We are having a new kitchen fitted

strengths.en: The start and end are friendly but not over-familiar — exactly semi-formal.
strengths.kk: Басы мен соңы достық, бірақ тым жақын емес — нағыз semi-formal.
strengths.ru: Начало и концовка дружелюбные, но без фамильярности — как раз semi-formal.
strengths.example: Thank you in advance for your patience and understanding.

note.en: The neighbour is known but not a close friend, so the opening uses his surname: semi-formal.
note.kk: Көрші таныс, бірақ жақын емес — тегімен қаратпа, semi-formal.
note.ru: Сосед знаком, но не близко — обращение по фамилии, semi-formal.

note.en: A friendly start (“I hope you are well”) and the purpose of the letter.
note.kk: Достық басталу («I hope you are well») және хаттың мақсаты.
note.ru: Дружелюбное начало («I hope you are well») и цель письма.

note.en: Bullet 1: what the work is, when it starts and how long it lasts.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — қандай жұмыс, қашан және қанша уақыт.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — какие работы, когда и сколько продлятся.

note.en: Bullet 2: the inconvenience, honestly but gently — “I am afraid”, “may”.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — қолайсыздықтар шыншыл әрі жұмсақ: «I am afraid», «may».
note.ru: Пункт 2 — неудобства честно и мягко: «I am afraid», «may».

note.en: Bullet 3: specific measures and an invitation to get in touch.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — конкретные меры и приглашение обращаться.

note.en: Thanks in advance — a natural ending for this kind of request.
note.kk: Алдын ала алғыс — мұндай өтініштің табиғи соңы.
note.ru: Благодарность заранее — естественная концовка для такой просьбы.

note.en: “Kind regards” is a neutral, polite sign-off for someone you know.
note.kk: «Kind regards» — таныс алушыға бейтарап сыпайы қолтаңба.
note.ru: «Kind regards» — нейтрально-вежливая подпись для знакомого адресата.
